verdict.rationale: HumanLayer orchestrates coding-agent sessions (Claude Code, Codex), so letting users plug in MCP servers is a fair question for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions MCP or registering external tool servers. The closest items are host-level access to tools (docs-7) and bring-your-own-harness (docs-31), which are host-platform and adjacent capabilities and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
